docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,550.00 FILED BY HOMESHARE, INC. AS TO DEFENDANT RICHARDSON, TRAVANTE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-17-2018 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $122.50 SERVED NOV-02-2018, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT RICHARDSON, TRAVANTE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-17-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-17-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF HOME SHARE IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY ASHTON LUONG. DEFENDANT TRAVANTE RICHARSON IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS. FILED BY PLAINTIFF HOMESHARE, INC.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-17-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HOMESHARE, INC. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RICHARDSON, TRAVANTE $2,700.00 PRINCIPAL, $172.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,872.00, I CREDIT PLAINTIFF'S EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT DID NOT PAY RENT IN AUGUST OR SEPTEMBER. DEFENDANT MOVED OUT PURSUANT TO AN EVICTION NOTICE ON OCT 1; BY THAT NOTICE PLAINTIFF TERMINATED THE AGREEMENT AND DEFENDANT DOES NOT OWE ADDITIONAL RENT. DEFENDANT MAY MAKE PAYMENT IN INSTALLMENTS AS SET BELOW. PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE AT THE RATE OF $600.00 PER MONTH, BEGINNING ON FEB-01-2019 AND ON THE 1ST DAY OF EACH MONTH THEREAFTER STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
